note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording (and the OT renderings made in its register); the introduction's credit line now names OWB. The English edition keeps the BSB; this Amharic edition quotes the Amharic Bible, now OWB, as Books 1 and 3 do.

Each day opens with its key verse and then re-quotes pieces of it; every piece now reads as the same OWB span as the key verse. A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' where the English elides. Where the author's prose defines or picks up a word from the verse, that word follows OWB: Proverbs 20:7 «ይኖራሉ», Proverbs 11:3 «ተንኮል», Proverbs 11:1 «ይጸየፋል», Proverbs 18:1 «ማግለል», Mark 1:35 «ገለልተኛ ስፍራ», Romans 16:19 «በበጎ ነገር ጥበበኞች … ከክፉ ነገር ንጹሕ», 2 Timothy 2:22 «የወጣትነት ምኞት … ተከታተል», 1 Timothy 4:7-8 «ለእግዚአብሔር ያደረ ሕይወት», Philippians 3:14 «ሽልማት … ቀጥ ብዬ ወደ ግቡ እሮጣለሁ», 1 John 3:18 «በምንናገረው ወይም በአንደበታችን», and the chapter titles of Days 27, 29 and 30 («ጌታዬና አምላኬ!», «ትወደኛለህ?», «አንተ ግን ተከተለኝ!»). OWB's inner «» become ‹› inside a quotation.
